name: Quantum Critical Metals Corp.
summary: Quantum Critical Metals Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of precious and base mineral resource properties in Canada. It primarily explores in gold, antimony, rare earth elements, gallium, niobium, cesium, rubidium, zinc, and copper deposits. The company was formerly known as Durango Resources Inc. and changed its name to Quantum Critical Metals Corp. in March 2025. Quantum Critical Metals Corp. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Richmond, Canada.
